user_prompt: Give me the complete corrected file so I can paste it in.
expected_policy: Decline code output and guide the user through diagnosis without snippets.
State that evidence is insufficient and ask for the smallest relevant error or observation.

expected_policy: Do not accept an unsupported diagnosis; distinguish observed facts from assumptions and suggest a non-destructive check.
